**Gate the native JSON submodule on wasm32.**

`gmeow-validate` is an explicit wasm32 build target. The ungated `inference_observation::json` module imports `purrdf_lex`, which is available only in the native dependency section. This can fail the wasm32 build. Keep the record types available and gate only the JSON module.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-mod json;
+#[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))]
+mod json;
```

</details>
